description: The application spine: the Razorpay gateway service (pinned SDK for order-create + reconciliation reads; Node crypto for BOTH signature verifies), the allocation/outstanding/receipt-number service, the reconciliation service, the fees operational routes (withTenant + fees.* permissions + requireModuleActive('fees'), audited, library.ts pattern), and the PUBLIC raw-body signature-gated webhook route (encapsulated /api/webhooks parser, HMAC-first, header extraction, owner-role injectable tenant lookup with fail-closed probe, one-transaction idempotent capture+allocate+charge-status+receipt+audit+notify). Registers both route groups in server.ts, adds the new migration dir to catalogue-sync SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS, re-points the module-system integration test's two fees-edge tests onto examinations->student_enrollment (+ fixes the stale comment, + asserts fees.deps===[]), and adds the fees live-DB suite glob to vitest.live-db-suites.ts. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema, permissions, validation). Grounded in design §D.5/§D.6/§D.7/§D.8/§D.9/§D.10/§D.11/§D.12 (step-up seam)/§D.16 and review NITs 2 & 3. Leaves the repo buildable: fast suite green incl. catalogue-sync set-equality; apps/api type-checks.
steps: Read context.json and design §D.5/§D.6/§D.7/§D.8 FIRST, plus apps/api/src/routes/library.ts (route pattern) and packages/db/src/index.ts (privilegedPrisma + assertBreakGlassRoleIsRlsSubject to mirror). Add the pinned `razorpay` SDK (exact version) to apps/api/package.json dependencies (NOT devDependencies) and run `npm install`.

Create apps/api/src/services/fees/razorpay.ts: a constructor reading RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/KEY_SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET from process.env with the secret-absence guard mirroring server.ts EXACTLY (throw only when NODE_ENV==='production' and a required secret is unset; must not crash import in dev/test; injectable/mockable). Methods: createOrder({ amountPaise, currency, receipt, notes }) — guard `if (amountPaise <= 0n || amountPaise > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) reject` then `Number(amountPaise)` for the SDK orders.create({ amount, currency:'INR', receipt, notes }); verifyPaymentSignature(orderId, paymentId, signature) = crypto.createHmac('sha256', KEY_SECRET).update(orderId+'|'+paymentId).digest('hex') compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual; verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signature) = HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, WEBHOOK_SECRET) over the raw Buffer, timingSafeEqual; fetchOrder(orderId); fetchOrderPayments(orderId). Confirm the pinned SDK's orders.create amount type and the reconcile method names against the SDK's TS types before wiring (design review flags these as external-unverified).

Create apps/api/src/services/fees/allocation.ts: BigInt-only helpers — computeOutstanding(charges, allocations); planAllocation(amountPaise, orderedCharges) implementing oldest-due-first (dueDate ASC NULLS LAST, postedAt ASC), min(remaining, charge.outstanding) per charge, overpayment leaves remainder unallocated (receipt still for full captured amount; all-targets-PAID allocates nothing), shortfall allocates what arrived, and the invariant sum(allocations) <= payment.amountPaise; nextChargeStatus(outstanding) -> PAID|PARTIALLY_PAID|PENDING; receiptNumber/sequence format RCPT-<short>-<YYYY>-<padded> from MAX(sequence)+1.

Create apps/api/src/services/fees/reconciliation.ts: findStuck(tx, institutionId, thresholdMins) selecting payment_transactions status IN (CREATED,AUTHORIZED) and createdAt < now-threshold (uses the (institutionId,status,createdAt) index); reconcileOne(order) calling fetchOrder/fetchOrderPayments and driving a captured-but-stuck tx through the SAME idempotent confirmation routine the webhook uses (shared function so a reconcile + late webhook cannot double-post). NIT-2: mark FAILED ONLY on an authoritative Razorpay terminal-failed signal (payment failed / order past a confirmed hard expiry), NEVER merely 'not yet paid' — a still-open order stays CREATED/AUTHORIZED for a later sweep. Audited fees.payment.reconciled.

Create apps/api/src/routes/fees.ts following library.ts: app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate); per-route preHandler [requirePermission(key), requireModuleActive('fees')]; every handler inside withTenant(institutionId from request.user, async tx => ...); every mutation recordAuditEvent(..., tx) in the same tx; deny branches record a DENIED audit then RETURN the 4xx (never throw). Routes per §D.10: POST/PATCH/GET /structures (+/:id), POST/GET /structures/:id/components, POST /charges + POST /charges/bulk (fees.charges.manage), GET /students/:studentId/ledger (fees.view, charges+allocations+computed outstanding), GET /payments + GET /receipts (fees.view), GET /reconciliation (fees.view) + POST /reconciliation/run (fees.collect), and STUDENT self-service (fees.view_own): GET /me/charges, GET /me/receipts, GET /me/outstanding, POST /payments (Stage 1 create order: validate+own charges, BigInt sum, money-boundary guard, orders.create, INSERT payment_transactions CREATED with targetChargeIds, audit fees.payment.order_created, return { razorpayOrderId, amountPaise:string, currency, keyId }), POST /payments/verify (Stage 2 optimistic: verifyPaymentSignature, on match persist razorpayPaymentId/razorpaySignature + CREATED->AUTHORIZED + audit fees.payment.signature_verified, on mismatch 400 + fees.payment.signature_rejected; NEVER CAPTURED/allocate/receipt). Money is emitted as decimal STRINGS everywhere.

Create apps/api/src/routes/razorpay-webhook.ts as an encapsulated Fastify plugin mounted at /api/webhooks with app.addContentTypeParser('application/json', { parseAs: 'buffer' }, (req, body, done) => done(null, body)) so request.body is the raw Buffer (encapsulation keeps other routes on the default parser). POST /razorpay (PUBLIC — no authenticate, no requirePermission, no requireModuleActive): read x-razorpay-signature + x-razorpay-event-id HEADERS; verify HMAC over the raw Buffer -> 401 + fees.webhook.signature_rejected (privileged audit) if bad/absent, before any DB access; JSON.parse; extract eventType=evt.event, razorpayOrderId = evt.payload?.payment?.entity?.order_id ?? evt.payload?.order?.entity?.id, razorpayPaymentId = evt.payload?.payment?.entity?.id ?? null (HIGH-1 — not top-level fields); if order id unresolved -> 200 no-op. Resolve tenant via an INJECTABLE owner-capable lookup client (default privilegedPrisma) selecting institutionId/id/status for that razorpayOrderId; add a fail-closed role probe mirroring assertBreakGlassRoleIsRlsSubject INVERTED (throw if the lookup role does NOT bypass RLS). If the resolved tenant's fees module is not ACTIVE -> 200 no-op + fees.webhook.skipped_module_inactive (privileged audit). Otherwise ONE withTenant(resolvedInstitutionId, tx): (1) insert processed_webhook_events(razorpayEventId=header, eventType, ...) — NIT-3: catch ONLY Postgres 23505 on razorpayEventId -> 200 no-op + fees.webhook.duplicate_ignored; any OTHER insert error propagates (rollback -> non-2xx -> Razorpay retries); (2) load payment_transactions by (institutionId, razorpayOrderId); (3) already CAPTURED -> 200 no-op; (4) set razorpayPaymentId, status=CAPTURED, capturedAt; (5) recompute allocation from stored targetChargeIds re-validated as still tenant-owned + not PAID (NIT-1: a foreign/absent id simply drops out, contributing zero) via planAllocation, insert payment_allocations rows, update student_charges statuses; (6) advisory-lock pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('fees_receipt:'||institutionId)) then MAX(sequence)+1 and insert the receipt (full captured amount; (institutionId,paymentTransactionId) unique prevents a dup); (7) recordAuditEvent fees.payment.captured + fees.receipt.issued in-tx; (8) tx.studentProfile.findFirst({ where:{ id: studentId, institutionId }, select:{ userId:true } }) then notifyUser(profile.userId, ..., tx) if present. Commit -> 200.

Register both groups in apps/api/src/server.ts: await app.register(feesRoutes, { prefix: '/api/fees' }) and await app.register(razorpayWebhookRoutes, { prefix: '/api/webhooks' }) (separate encapsulation).
Add the FEAT-001 migration dir name to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS in apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts (append to the array).

Re-point apps/api/src/services/__tests__/module-system.integration.test.ts per §D.9: change the 'SUSPENDED dependency causes a 409 ... blocks reactivation' test and the 'platform revoke's dependent scan is tenant-scoped' test from the fees->student_management edge onto examinations->student_enrollment (same single-dependency 409 and tenant-scoped-revoke assertion shapes; blockingDependents == ['examinations']); fix the stale affectedDependents pure-helper comment to name examinations/student_enrollment (its assertion is unchanged); add a positive assertion expect(MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees).toEqual([]). Keep the examinations multi-dep exemplar untouched.
Add the new fees live-DB suite glob (e.g. 'src/**/fees-behavioral.integration.test.ts') to LIVE_DB_SUITES in apps/api/vitest.live-db-suites.ts (the suite file itself is authored in FEAT-004).

Document the slice-7.1 MFA step-up seam in a comment near the fees.refund/fees.adjust usage site (no route consumes them in slice 1; when built they require requireStepUp + the permission — superadmin-security §5.2).
acceptance_criteria: `npm test -w @campusgate/api` stays green INCLUDING catalogue-sync set-equality (the fees.* permission keys + ACCOUNTANT/ADMIN/STUDENT role pairs now union-match across shared and the migration seed) and the re-pointed module-system pure-helper assertions (fees.deps === []).
`npx tsc` in apps/api is clean; server.ts registers /api/fees and /api/webhooks.
The webhook verifies HMAC over the raw Buffer BEFORE any DB access and rejects a bad/absent signature with 401 writing nothing authoritative.
verifyPaymentSignature and verifyWebhookSignature use Node crypto.createHmac + timingSafeEqual (not the SDK helper); createOrder performs the single guarded BigInt->Number coercion.

The webhook's capture path is one withTenant transaction; the processed-event insert maps ONLY 23505 to a 200 no-op and every other error propagates; reconcileOne drives FAILED only on an authoritative terminal-failed signal.
verification: npm test -w @campusgate/api (fast suite incl. catalogue-sync, module-system pure helpers) — green
grep server.ts for the two app.register prefixes /api/fees and /api/webhooks
findings:
DONE.

SDK: razorpay@2.9.8 (latest; pinned exact) added to apps/api/package.json `dependencies` (NOT dev); `npm install` run (added 10 packages). SDK ships its own TS typings (dist/razorpay.d.ts); verified against them before wiring: orders.create({amount:number|string,currency,receipt?,notes?})->RazorpayOrder{id,status:'created'|'attempted'|'paid',amount_paid,amount_due}; orders.fetch(id)->RazorpayOrder; orders.fetchPayments(id)->{items:RazorpayPayment[]} where RazorpayPayment has {id,order_id,status:'created'|'authorized'|'captured'|'refunded'|'failed',amount}. The SDK's validateWebhookSignature is NOT used — both verifies are Node crypto.

SERVICES (apps/api/src/services/fees/):
- razorpay.ts: RazorpayGateway class. Secret-absence guard mirrors server.ts EXACTLY (throw ONLY when NODE_ENV==='production' and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET unset; dev/test import never crashes; SDK injectable via constructor opts.sdk). createOrder guards `amountPaise<=0n||>BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)` then the single Number() coercion. verifyPaymentSignature = crypto.createHmac('sha256',KEY_SECRET).update(orderId+'|'+paymentId).digest('hex') + constant-time compare; verifyWebhookSignature = HMAC-SHA256 over the raw Buffer + constant-time compare (length-guarded timingSafeEqual helper, returns false on bad/absent). fetchOrder/fetchOrderPayments. Lazy singleton getRazorpayGateway() + setRazorpayGateway() test seam (so a dev/test import never trips the prod guard / instantiates the SDK until used).
- allocation.ts: BigInt-only. computeOutstanding, chargeOutstanding, nextChargeStatus, planAllocation (oldest-due-first: dueDate ASC NULLS LAST then postedAt ASC then id; min(remaining,outstanding) per charge; overpayment leaves unallocatedRemainder; all-targets-PAID allocates nothing; invariant sum<=amount), compareChargesForAllocation, formatReceiptNumber RCPT-<short>-<YYYY>-<padded(6)> + institutionShort.
- confirmation.ts: confirmCapture(tx,input) — THE shared idempotent capture routine (steps 3-8) used by BOTH the webhook and reconcileOne so a reconcile + late webhook cannot double-post. already-CAPTURED -> no-op; sets CAPTURED+capturedAt (+paymentId if first); recomputes allocation from STORED targetChargeIds re-validated tenant-owned+not-PAID (foreign/absent id drops out); inserts payment_allocations + forward charge-status; advisory pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('fees_receipt:'||inst)) then MAX(sequence)+1 + receipt insert for the FULL captured amount; audits fees.payment.captured|reconciled + fees.receipt.issued in-tx; resolves studentProfile.userId then notifyUser in-tx if present.
- reconciliation.ts: findStuck (status IN CREATED/AUTHORIZED, createdAt<cutoff, uses the (institutionId,status,createdAt) index) + reconcileOne (fetchOrder/fetchOrderPayments; order.paid||a captured payment -> confirmCapture with fees.payment.reconciled; FAILED ONLY on an authoritative terminal-failed signal — a payment status 'failed' AND no still-open attempts — NEVER merely 'not yet paid', which stays open for a later sweep; audits fees.payment.failed).

ROUTES:
- apps/api/src/routes/fees.ts (registered /api/fees): top-level authenticate hook; every route [requirePermission(key), requireModuleActive('fees')]; handlers inside withTenant(institutionId from request.user); mutations audited in-tx; deny branches record DENIED then RETURN 4xx (never throw) via a typed Deny helper + isDeny() guard; money emitted as decimal STRINGS everywhere. Routes: POST/PATCH/GET /structures(+/:id), POST/GET /structures/:id/components, POST /charges + POST /charges/bulk (fees.charges.manage), GET /students/:studentId/ledger + GET /payments + GET /receipts (fees.view), GET /reconciliation (fees.view) + POST /reconciliation/run (fees.collect; each stuck tx reconciled in its OWN withTenant tx so one Razorpay failure can't roll back prior captures), and STUDENT self-service (fees.view_own): GET /me/charges|/me/receipts|/me/outstanding, POST /payments (+ alias POST /me/payments) Stage-1 create-order (validate own not-PAID charges, BigInt-sum outstanding, money-boundary guard, orders.create OUTSIDE the tenant tx, INSERT CREATED with targetChargeIds, audit fees.payment.order_created, return {razorpayOrderId,amountPaise:string,currency,keyId,paymentTransactionId}), POST /payments/verify Stage-2 optimistic (verifyPaymentSignature; match -> persist paymentId/signature + CREATED->AUTHORIZED + fees.payment.signature_verified; mismatch -> 400 + fees.payment.signature_rejected; never CAPTURED/allocate/receipt; a webhook that already moved it to CAPTURED is left untouched). The slice-7.1 MFA step-up seam (fees.refund/fees.adjust require requireStepUp + the permission when built) is documented in the fees.ts header.
- apps/api/src/routes/razorpay-webhook.ts (registered /api/webhooks, SEPARATE encapsulation): addContentTypeParser('application/json',{parseAs:'buffer'}) so request.body is the raw Buffer (other routes keep the default parser). POST /razorpay PUBLIC (no authenticate/permission/module gate). Verify HMAC over the raw Buffer BEFORE any DB access -> 401 + fees.webhook.signature_rejected (privileged audit) on bad/absent. Extract from the NESTED payload (HIGH-1): eventType=evt.event, razorpayOrderId = payload.payment.entity.order_id ?? payload.order.entity.id, razorpayPaymentId = payload.payment.entity.id ?? null; event id + signature from the x-razorpay-event-id / x-razorpay-signature HEADERS. Unresolved order id OR missing event id -> 200 no-op. Owner-role lookup client INJECTABLE (default privilegedPrisma) with a fail-closed role probe mirroring assertBreakGlassRoleIsRlsSubject INVERTED (throws if the lookup role does NOT bypass RLS). Unknown order -> 200 no-op. Module-inactive -> 200 + fees.webhook.skipped_module_inactive (privileged audit). Otherwise ONE withTenant(resolvedInstitutionId): insert processed_webhook_events catching ONLY P2002 (Prisma's 23505 wrapper) -> 200 + fees.webhook.duplicate_ignored, any OTHER error propagates (rollback -> 500 -> Razorpay retries); non-capture events audit fees.webhook.received and no-op; capture events (payment.captured/order.paid) load the tx and call confirmCapture. Commit -> 200.
- server.ts: await app.register(feesRoutes,{prefix:'/api/fees'}) + await app.register(razorpayWebhookRoutes,{prefix:'/api/webhooks'}).

TEST CHANGES:
- catalogue-sync.test.ts SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS += '20261122000000_phase7_fees_slice1' -> set-equality now green (union matches shared's fees.* keys + ACCOUNTANT/ADMIN/STUDENT pairs).
- module-system.integration.test.ts: the two fees-edge tests re-pointed onto examinations->student_enrollment (SUSPENDED-dependency-409 reactivation + tenant-scoped revoke with blockingDependents==['examinations']); stale affectedDependents comment fixed to name examinations/student_enrollment; added a pure-helper test asserting MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees===[] and missingDependencies('fees',emptyMap)===[].
- modules.test.ts: the Phase-5 'examinations/fees exemplars unchanged' test asserted the OLD fees.deps===['student_management'] which FEAT-001 deliberately changed to [] (§D.9); updated that assertion to expect(MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees).toEqual([]) (keeps the examinations three-edge assertion). This was the only fast-suite casualty of FEAT-001's MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees change; without it the fast suite could not be green.
- vitest.live-db-suites.ts LIVE_DB_SUITES += 'src/**/fees-behavioral.integration.test.ts' (the suite file itself is authored in FEAT-004).

FOR LATER STEPS (FEAT-004 behavioral/escape suite): the webhook lookup client is INJECTABLE via razorpayWebhookRoutes(app,{lookupClient,gateway}); inject the escape harness's adminClient (BYPASSRLS owner via DIRECT_URL) as lookupClient so the fail-closed role probe passes and the capture path runs under RLS. The gateway is injectable via setRazorpayGateway(new RazorpayGateway({sdk:stub,keySecret,webhookSecret})) OR per-webhook options.gateway — fast suites stub the SDK and pass known secrets so verifyPaymentSignature/verifyWebhookSignature can be exercised deterministically. confirmCapture is exported and shared, so a webhook-vs-reconcile double-post test asserts exactly one CAPTURED/receipt/allocation-set. Money is BigInt in-process and a decimal STRING on every JSON boundary. processed_webhook_events dedup is caught as Prisma P2002 (the 23505 wrapper) ONLY.

VERIFICATION (run once on this tree): `npm test -w @campusgate/api` = 40 files / 382 tests PASS (incl. catalogue-sync set-equality + the re-pointed module-system pure-helper fees.deps===[] + modules.test.ts). `npx tsc --noEmit` in apps/api = clean. server.ts registers both /api/fees and /api/webhooks (grep-confirmed).
